brief: Prioritise Eastvale Reach for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with high loading histories have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat events, as outlined in MG-023. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period pursuant to MG-021.
